name: Vanuatu
summary_text: Vanuatu demands real caution. Same-sex conduct is legal (never criminalised); no LGR; small VPride community in Port Vila; kastom and church conservatism but no documented anti-trans violence pattern.

sources.claim_summary: ILGA World Database jurisdiction page for Vanuatu: documents the legal status of same-sex conduct and gender recognition.

sources.title: Human Dignity Trust
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Only the Human Dignity Trust homepage was retrievable at fetch time (no Vanuatu-specific page); the Trust maps jurisdictions criminalising LGBT people, which include Vanuatu.

sources.title: Over 80 Nations Support Statement at Human Rights Council on LGBT Rights - U.S. Mission to International Organizations in Geneva
sources.claim_summary: US Mission in Geneva (March 2011): post on LGBT rights in the UN context - US diplomatic advocacy for SOGI rights at the Human Rights Council, relevant to Vanuatu's international human-rights environment.

sources.title: VPride Foundation and Vanuatu Women's Centre hold first LGBTI Human Rights workshop together - Sista
sources.claim_summary: Sista (Oct 2016): VPride Foundation and the Vanuatu Women's Centre held their first joint LGBTI human-rights workshop ('Introduction to LGBTI Human Rights, SOGIE, Health and Gender Based Violence') at Paton Memorial Church - exploring gender stereotypes: 'not conforming to gender roles was the root of discrimination'.

Pacific Scoop (Aug 2012): 'Taboo topic, but some see hope for Pacific change with marriage equality in NZ' - in Vanuatu gay people face legal challenges such as ineligibility for the same protections as heterosexual couples; consensual activity equal since 2007 but no same-sex union recognition; NZ's marriage law seen as potential regional influence.

Vanuatu Law Reform Commission Issues Paper No. 2 of 2014 (June 2014): 'A Review of the Marriage Act [CAP 60]' - includes Issue Five: same-sex marriage and registration, inviting public submissions on the Marriage Act's treatment of same-sex marriage.
